content.short: Disco Solaris is a Cardano NFT collection with sci-fi lore, starship themes, collector art, and lore.
content.description: Disco Solaris is a Cardano NFT collection built around a sci-fi story of selected travelers boarding a starship toward Neo Miami, an off-world city created by a mysterious inventor. The project uses narrative, character identity, and futuristic visual themes to give holders a collectible experience beyond static artwork. It belongs to the Cardano NFT ecosystem as a lore-driven collection where art, rarity, and community updates shape interest. Disco Solaris focuses on storytelling, digital ownership, and collector culture.
